recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for current FHIR core. If HL7 still wants the old R4 publication artifact corrected, handle that through historical publication/generator tooling rather than by editing current core source.
issue_request: FHIR-25275 reported that canonical.value in canonical.profile.json had structuredefinition-fhir-type valueUrl "string" in the snapshot but "canonical" in the differential; Jira status is Published with Persuasive resolution, and FHIR-I minutes auto-approved it as a technical correction with a note that R4 should also be fixed.
initial_application: No FHIR core source commit directly mentions FHIR-25275. Jira points to HL7/kindling#69, and local Kindling history shows commit 1b0392b0e5e8d7f9a3076edf364226eac35251fb changing primitive profile generation from hard-coded fhir-type "string" to type.getCode(), later included in commit 962c1c66413df22ef54d00b6c4821b1788014dc9 that explicitly cites FHIR-25275.
additional_context: The current source defines canonical as a uri-based primitive with JSON string representation; ElementDefinition guidance explains that FHIRPath System.String can carry structuredefinition-fhir-type to constrain the value to a FHIR datatype. Although the original Jira description called the snapshot string value correct, the accepted Kindling implementation and adjacent current primitive profiles align snapshot and differential to the primitive type code: string uses string, uri uses uri, uuid uses uuid, and canonical uses canonical. Historical R4 still shows the old mismatch, but R5 and current CI output are consistent. The same Kindling fhir-type generator family includes FHIR-36036, already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current FHIR checkout has no missing source hunk for canonical.value fhir-type, and current generated canonical.profile.json in R5 and build.fhir.org already emits valueUrl "canonical" in both snapshot and differential. Changing current core source to force "string" would conflict with the generator fix and the current primitive profile pattern.

related_jiras.note: The same Kindling fhir-type generator change corrected Element/BackboneElement id metadata; it is already represented on the combined branch.
Documents the FHIRPath System.String plus structuredefinition-fhir-type pattern that supports leaving the base code as System.String while the extension carries the constrained FHIR type.

evidence_items.summary: ElementDefinition guidance explains that FHIRPath System.String elements can carry structuredefinition-fhir-type to constrain them to a corresponding FHIR datatype.
evidence_items.learned: This supports interpreting canonical.value valueUrl canonical as the intended constraint while the base code remains FHIRPath System.String.

evidence_items.learned: The initial application was an external generator fix that intentionally makes primitive fhir-type values match their primitive code.
